# Leading break indentation

Original XML controls generated by `tools/leading_break_indent_fixture.py`,
with native PDFs exported by the reference application using
`tools/export-reference.ps1`. No third-party template assets are used.
`tools/record_leading_break_indent.py` records source/PDF hashes and first-text
positions in `reference.json`.

ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.3.1.12 defines first-line and hanging indentation;
§17.3.3.1 defines run breaks. The treatment of a leading pagination break as
consuming the first text line is not explicit. These controls establish the reference application's
behavior: leading page/column breaks preserve first-line indentation, including
two consecutive page breaks and positive first-line indentation. Preceding text,
space, tab, manual line break, or a list marker consumes the first line.

Browser tests compare native page, x position, baseline and first-line wrapping,
then exercise insertion, package preservation, exact undo and editable reopen.
Unit tests bind the native evidence to source hashes and check continuation
indentation and export/reimport. Existing cell-break browser cases protect the
separate behavior of breaks inside table cells.
